arguments.sql:
SELECT
    p.PreferenceSeq,
    COUNT(*) AS preference_count,
    COUNT(m.StyleID) AS matched_preference_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT m.StyleID) AS styles_with_preference,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM main.Musical_Styles) AS total_styles
FROM main.Musical_Preferences AS p
LEFT JOIN main.Musical_Styles AS m ON m.StyleID = p.StyleID
GROUP BY p.PreferenceSeq
ORDER BY p.PreferenceSeq

arguments.sql:
SELECT
    s.StyleName,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN p.PreferenceSeq = 1 THEN 1 END) AS FirstPreferenceCount,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN p.PreferenceSeq = 2 THEN 1 END) AS SecondPreferenceCount,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN p.PreferenceSeq = 3 THEN 1 END) AS ThirdPreferenceCount
FROM main.Musical_Styles AS s
LEFT JOIN main.Musical_Preferences AS p ON p.StyleID = s.StyleID
GROUP BY s.StyleID, s.StyleName
ORDER BY s.StyleName, s.StyleID
LIMIT -1
